title: The Urbz: Sims in the City
iso_basename: Urbz, The - Sims in the City (Europe) (En,Fr,De,Es,It,Nl,Sv,No,Da,Fi,Pl).iso
multiplayer_goal: Shared memory-card netplay implemented; Linux/Linux and Linux/Windows via Wine loopback, persistence and simulated WAN latency validated. Physical PCs, real Internet and long sessions remain unvalidated.
internet_transport: Direct public IPv4/TCP with OpenSSL TLS 1.2 DHE-PSK AES-128-GCM and random shared session key. Router port forwarding and externally reachable IPv4 required; no VPN/cloud server required.
netplay_shared_save: Host-authoritative memory card synchronized before boot execution; client previous card backed up; native game Save menu persists progress
netplay_graphics_compatibility: Internal scale, 2D filtering and widescreen must match; FSR1, presentation look and output size may differ. Enforced before shared-card transfer.
graphics_measurement_scope: Original graphics benchmark is historical. Updated one-thread first-district benchmark exceeds full PAL capacity at 1x/2x, below at 4x. See DESEMPENHO.md.
offline_rendering: Parallel window renderer, CPU/VU on one simulation thread, current framebuffer readbacks; original PAL game timing preserved.
netplay_rendering: Parallel window renderer with exact current framebuffer readbacks and CPU/VU together; headless remains sequential.
fps60_investigation: Experimental clock-corrected 60Hz candidate reached about 52 distinct images/s at 1x with matching repeated checkpoints; physics and campaign unvalidated. No supported 60FPS preset shipped.
spatial_upscaler: Optional FSR1 EASU + RCAS, WGSL FP32 adaptation of AMD MIT reference; final presentation only, no temporal reconstruction or frame generation.
output_resolution: Optional 2560x1440 request; compositor/desktop controls actual drawable size.
widescreen: Optional 16:9 camera projection plus centered Apt UI affine transform; two-player district geometry/HUD measured. Further cameras, menus and campaign remain experimental.
